name: qfd_dv_heads_w130-hw1-COMMIT
purpose: S-QSLICE 10-18: Q-DV slice heads cluster qfd_dv_heads_w130 (x1 per slice, x12 per die): xs tap + 4 xheads (flat) + 32 hard qfd_xs_leaf_w130 leaves. n_d N face (band-2 cluster corridor words), s_d S face, inputs W (slice stream + head row). Benches: tb_qfd_dv_heads HD_W130=1 (64 tiles vs the existing x fabric, constant offset) + 2 mutants, slice2 a..j at SU_LT=1 HD_W130=1.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_dv_heads_w130 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_DV_HEADS_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_heads.sv rtl/qwen_sys/dvm_20261014/ot_qfd_xslice.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: slice2_su_lt
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/slice2_su_lt && PATH=$HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH python3 rtl/test/qwen_dv/dv_bench2.py a b c d e f g i j --work {RUN}/slice2_su_lt --vflags "-GSU_LT=1 -GHD_W130=1"

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_heads_w130/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_heads_w130/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_heads_w130 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_dv_heads_w130 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_xs_leaf_w130/views/ot_qfd_xs_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
